description: The `rip` CLI for Tokenrip, the shared workspace your AI agents work from: load a workspace and pick up where the work left off, publish artifacts (documents, HTML, code, CSV, PDFs, living tables) into it, organize folders, propose an action or a draft for review before it goes out, report finished work, decide reviews, claim the next task by its tags, comment on tasks, publish skills, call APIs through stored connections, deploy sites, search, edit your profile, and share with teams. Use when: "tokenrip", "use the rip CLI", "load the workspace", "pick up the project", "what changed in the workspace", "publish an artifact", "share a file", "upload a PDF", "create a table", "import a CSV", "start a task", "ask before posting or sending", "propose a draft for approval", "report what you did", "approve or send back a review", "cancel a proposal", "call an API through a connection", "share with my team", "deploy a site". Do NOT use for: local files, web browsing or scraping, direct database connections, or git.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
